csv_project_name: A/E Service for Build Elevator Tower for Building 25
csv_agency: Veterans Affairs Medical Center Regional Office
csv_scope_of_work: The VA Central Western Massachusetts in Leeds, MA requires an Architect and Engineering Firm to perform work which includes provide all professional architectural and engineering (A/E) Part One Services (also known as Design Phase Type A & Type B Services) necessary to develop complete drawings, specifications, and cost estimates associated with building a new elevator tower at Building 25. A/E Part Two Services of this design project (also known as Construction Period Services) includes responding to construction contractor Requests For Information (RFIs) during the solicitation (solicitation support) and construction phases of the construction project, attendance at post-award and commissioning kick off construction project conferences, review of construction material submittals and shop drawings, attendance at weekly teleconference construction meetings , approximately 1 site visits per month during active construction (both scheduled and emergent) to ensure compliance with the design drawings and specifications, preparation of site visit reports, coordination with project commissioning requirements/QEI inspection, review of any construction project modifications for cost and technical acceptability, attendance and participation during the pre-final inspection and final acceptance inspection, preparation of the punch list and preparation of record drawings of the completed construction project based on the construction contractor s as-built drawings. The A/E shall prepare a submittal log to be utilized by the VA during construction period services and maintain a RFI log.421 North Main Street Leeds MA POSTAL CODE 01053 COUNTRY US
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Mechanical Engineering

project_scope: Architectural and engineering services for a new elevator tower at Building 25 for the VA Central Western Massachusetts campus. services: Full A/E services including Part One design services and Part Two construction-period services; disciplines requested: architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, construction/project management, and mechanical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Small building-related accessibility project with limited structural ambition.
- Main scope is general A/E design for an elevator tower, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Includes civil and architectural services, but no indication of complex structural engineering challenges.
- Construction-period services are included, yet the project appears routine and low-priority for sbp.

fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the source. Useful basis: full A/E design plus construction-period services for a project with total construction cost stated at 1.0M-5.0M.
